title: Electron installer for ACS distribution
description:
Set up an Electron app that serves as both the installer and GUI for the ACS system.

## Requirements
- Electron app bundles the ACS binary and installs it on the user's system
- The bundled frontend reads the ACS daemon's port info and connects to it
- Provides a GUI to manage the ACS system (view/create/edit/delete jobs, view logs, etc.)
- Installer handles first-time setup (installing the acs binary, setting up the daemon service)
- The Electron shell wraps the existing Next.js frontend, pointing it at the local ACS daemon

## Key Decisions
- How to detect/read the daemon's port (config file, default port, discovery)
- Installer flow: install binary, start daemon, launch GUI
- Platform targets: Windows first, then macOS/Linux

## Acceptance Criteria
- User can download and run the Electron installer
- ACS binary is installed and daemon starts
- GUI connects to the running daemon and provides full management capabilities
close_reason: Electron installer fully implemented: monorepo setup, main process with static HTTP server, preload IPC bridge, system tray, dynamic route matching, connection status polling, electron-builder packaging, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and release scripts. All documentation audited and updated.

title: Stale PID detection fails on Windows - OpenProcess succeeds on dead processes
close_reason: Applied defensive fix: is_process_alive() now uses GetExitCodeProcess after OpenProcess on Windows. Unable to reproduce original zombie-handle scenario but fix applied preventatively.

comments.author: Jacob Tonna
comments.text: Attempted to reproduce the stale PID zombie-handle scenario by launching via AgentCronScheduler.exe (Electron), task-killing acs.exe, closing the unresponsive Electron window, then running acs.exe start from the CLI. Unable to reproduce — OpenProcess correctly returned null for the dead PID after the steps. The original occurrence may have been caused by Windows Task Scheduler or Electron holding a handle to the dead process in a specific timing window that cleared on reboot. Applied defensive fix anyway: is_process_alive() now calls GetExitCodeProcess() after OpenProcess() succeeds. If exit code != STILL_ACTIVE (259), the process is considered dead regardless of handle validity.

title: BUG: ScriptFile trigger args broken on Unix - passed as single filename arg
description: In executor.rs build_command(), ScriptFile with trigger args does cb.arg(&effective_script) where effective_script is 'deploy.sh --env staging'. On Unix this passes the entire concatenated string as a single argument to /bin/sh (without -c), so sh tries to open a file literally named 'deploy.sh --env staging'. Fix: For ScriptFile on Unix, use /bin/sh -c 'script args' or pass args separately. Need to write a test that validates the bug first, then fix. When fixed, update job-management.md ScriptFile trigger args section.
close_reason: Fixed: ScriptFile on Unix now uses /bin/sh -c when trigger args present. PowerShell uses -Command instead of -File when trigger args present. Tests added. Doc updated in job-management.md.

title: Add ANSI color rendering toggle to system logs
description: The system logs page displays raw ANSI escape codes as garbled characters. Add frontend-side ANSI rendering using the anser library, with a toggle to switch between colored output (ANSI rendered as HTML) and plain text (ANSI codes stripped). Persist toggle preference in localStorage.
close_reason: Implemented ANSI color rendering toggle with anser library, HTML escaping for XSS prevention, localStorage persistence, and search compatibility.

title: Auto-add ACS binary to user PATH on install/start
description: When the ACS daemon is installed or started for the first time, it should automatically add its binary location to the user-level PATH environment variable so that 'acs' can be called from any terminal without requiring the user to manually configure their PATH. This should use user-level PATH modification (not system-level) to avoid requiring elevated permissions. Platform-specific approaches: Windows - modify HKCU\Environment\Path registry key; macOS/Linux - append to ~/.bashrc, ~/.zshrc, or ~/.profile.

title: BUG: stderr pipe created but never read - output silently lost
description: NoPtySpawner sets stderr(Stdio::piped()) at pty/mod.rs:84 but NoPtyProcess::read() at lines 108-114 only reads from self.child.stdout. All stderr output is silently discarded. When this is fixed, update docs that say 'stdout only' back to 'stdout/stderr': job-management.md execution section, and any other references.
notes: Docs updated to say 'stdout only' in: job-management.md (line 189), architecture.md (section 5.3), storage.md (line 141). When this bug is fixed, change these back to 'stdout/stderr'.
